questions.stem_text: According toJellinek(1952) what progression does thelife ofan alcoholic usually follow ?

options.A: Onset phase, abuse phase, dependency phase, abstinence phase
options.B: Prealcoholic phase, alcoholic phase, recovery phase, relapse phase
options.C: Initial phase, adaptive phase, dependent phase, deteriorative phase
options.D: Experimental phase, social use phase, intensive use phase, compulsive use phase
options.E: Initial phase, middle phase, crucial phase, termination phase

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Onset phase, abuse phase, dependency phase, abstinence phase

questions.stem_text: Discuss the relationship between arousal and motivation.

options.A: Motivation can exist without any form of arousal.
options.B: Arousal level is a central aspect of motivation.
options.C: Motivation is the cause of arousal.
options.D: Motivation is a by-product of arousal.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Arousal level is a central aspect of motivation.

questions.stem_text: The denominator term in the F-ratio is reduced in magnitude by:

options.A: decreasing both within-group and between-group variability.
options.B: increasing both within-group and between-group variability.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - decreasing both within-group and between-group variability.
